skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Acquire vocabulary commonly used in IT fields.
Understand common grammar structures used in IT fields.
Apply grammar structures in various contexts such as writing essays, technical exchanges, and translations.
Ability to search for information and references in English for specialized knowledge.
Develop basic communication skills in English for IT.
Develop independent writing skills and group communication skills for discussing professional issues.
Develop self-directed learning abilities and responsibility towards social context and professional ethics in IT.
Develop collaborative group work skills and responsibility towards class discipline and activities assigned by instructors.
